title: Q1 webinar lead program
brief:
Subject: Q1 webinar lead program — Meridian Payroll (synthetic)

Hi team,

Meridian Payroll wants 1,200 qualified leads for its payroll software webinar series.
Budget: Rp96,000,000 for the full program.
Timeline: 6 weeks from kickoff.
Geography: Indonesia — Jabodetabek and Bandung.
A qualified lead is an HR or finance manager at a company with 100–1,000 employees who registers and attends at least one webinar.
Target segment: mid-size manufacturing and retail companies.
Reporting: weekly lead report in a shared sheet.

Thanks,
Rina (synthetic contact)
